buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up

to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of The Chief General Manager payable at Ordnance Factory Varangaon A unit of MIL . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED BID SPECIFIC ATC 1) Availability of Office of Service Provider: The registered office of service provider must be located in at least one of the following Districts: 1 Jalgaon (Maharashtra) 2 Dhule (Maharashtra) 3 Nashik (Maharashtra)

4 Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), (Maharashtra) 5 Jalna ((Maharashtra) 6 Buldhana (Maharashtra) 7 Burhanpur (Madhya Pradesh) Service provider must submit valid authorized document/Certificate issued by Central Govt. /State Govt., MSME (UDYAM) Certificate or GST registration Certificate mentioning office address in at least one of the a bove mentioned Districts for registered office address proof. Note: 1) Following documents will NOT be considered as office address proof: a) Letter of intimation. b) Rent agreement on Notary or any type of agreement between two parties c) Undertaking/Declaration by bidders for establishing office after award of contract. d) Intimation receipt of shop Act. e) Application for intimation of Shop act form F. f) Any documents/Certificate issued by agency other than Central Govt. /State Govt., MSME (UDYAM) Cer tificate and GST registration Certificate. 2) Any deviation in providing established office proof at location mentioned above will lead to the disqua lification of the bidder. 2) Payment Term: Monthly Payment on the basis of Service Entry Sheet issued by user section. 3) Minimum average Turn Over: Minimum average Turn Over of the bidder for last three years i.e. 2025- 26, 2024-2025, 2023-2024 must be 33 lakh or more. 4) EMD/Bid Security: Hard Copy of the EMD (bid security) will have to be submitted directly to the buyer, wherever applicable, w ithin 5 working days of bid opening, failing which the bid may be treated as incomplete & may lead to rejec tion of the bid by buyer without making any reference to the seller or submit Bid security Declaration in ca se firm has not submitted any valid document claiming EMD exemption. EMD to be sent at the following address: Chief General Manager/Ordnance Factory Varangaon Tal: Bhusawal, Dist.: Jalgaon Pin 425308 with kind a ttention to PV section. 5) Labour Codes (Applicable): Contractor should abide by the provisions of 04 new Labour codes issued by Government of India:- a) The code on Wages, 2019. b) The code on Social Security, 2020 c) The Industrial Relation Code,2020 d) The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020. 6) Employees Provident Fund: As per the EPFO order, the monthly wage ceiling limit for calculation of employer contribution for EPF, EPF admin, EDLI will be actual monthly wages or Rs. 25,000/- per month (or as amended by Government Order issued from time to time), whichever is lower. 7) Bonus: The monthly wage ceiling limit for eligibility for payment of Bonus will be Maximum Rs. 21,000/- per month (or as amended by Government Order issued from time to time). 8) Employees State Insurance: For ESIC, the monthly wage ceiling limit for coverage under the Act will be Maximum Rs. 21,000/- per mont h & Rs. 25,000/- per month for persons with Disability (or as amended by Government Order issued from ti me to time). However, the contractor shall provide Group Insurance to those Contract Worker who are not covered under ESIC (Whenever required). 9) Service Charge: Service Charge applicable at the time of utilization of services/payment of bill will be calculated based on t he ceiling limits for various elements viz. EPF/EPF admin/EDLI/ESIC/Bonus.

10) In addition, terms and conditions mentioned in scope of work will also be applicable. 11) Terms And Conditions for Execution Of Supply Order/Contract 1. At the commencement of the contract, the contractor shall submit the list of the contract workers who m he shall engage for the services in excess of the 30% of the required strength of the contractor workers per day to the user section. 2. The Contractor shall also submit the Bank Account Details (Xerox copy of Bank Passbook etc.) of the in dividual contract workers being engaged to the User section for verification. 3. List once finalized, the contractor shall not change contract workers without consent of Buyer. The ser vice provider shall ensure physical availability of him or his representative for inducting/passing out worker s through factory gate and supervise the work. 4. The contractor shall ensure that there is no duplication of EPF & ESI accounts Numbers vis-à-vis the c ontract workers previous employment with any other firms. 5. The contractor /Service provider shall ensure that, in all payment documents including attendance, w age muster & bank credit statement, name of all workers employed against contract be organized in alpha betical order similar to the arrangement used in EPF statement. 6. The Service provider will provide Consumables/ PPEs/ Uniform if any for routine work and will quote fo r the same under the column Percentage of Service charge inclusive of GST. 7. The successful bidder will have to produce GST bill for procurement of listed PPE kits to all Fireman an d Fire Engine Driver to be supplied against the supply order. The aforesaid documents are required to be produced at the time of claiming bill for the services supplied for 1st month. 12) All clauses of MIL Stores Procurement Manual 2023 available on the website of Munitions India Ltd. P une [https://munitionsindia.co.in] shall be applicable. 13) Arbitration Clause: Applicable as per MIL SPM Clause 7.41 :- “All disputes & differences arising out of or in any way touching or concerning this agreement (except thos e for which specific provision has been made therein) shall be referred to Sole Arbitrator to be appointed b y CMD, Munitions India Ltd. with the mutual consent of the parties. The Arbitrator so appointed shall be an officer of MIL (with mutual consent) who had not dealt with matter to which this agreement relates and in course of his duties had not expressed views on all or any of the matter in dispute or differences. The Awar d of Sole Arbitrator shall be final and binding on the parties.” 14) Price Variation Clause: Applicable as per minimum wages notifications published by office of Chief Labour Commissioner (C), Minis try of Labour Govt. of India from time to time. 15) As Per GeM GTC clause 29:- “A bidder shall submit only one bid in particular bidding process (unless otherwise allowed in the bid STC/A TC conditions). In case of a holding company having more than one independent manufacturing unit or mo re than one unit having common business ownership/management, only one unit should quote. Similar res trictions shall apply to closely related sister companies. Bidder’s sister/associated/allied concern means a company, society, and partnership firm ort proprietorship firm having one or more common persons as Dir ector / Partner / Member / Owner. A bidder who submits more than one bid will cause all the proposals sub mitted in the particular bid to be disqualified”. 16) SAFETY TERMS: The Contractor should follow all the safety and security rules and Regulations as applicable to OFV and abi de by security/ safety regulation for all purpose. LIST OF IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS:- 1) EMD Exemption Documents (As per GeM GTC 4.0) 2) UDYAM 3) Office address Proof: Issued by Central Govt., State Govt. /UDYAM Certificate/ GST registration Certific ate clearly mentioning office address at desired location mentioned by buyer. 4) Past Experience Certificate: Firm must submit copy of past executed orders of similar service with min imum one year tenure and completely executed before bid publication date. In case Past Experience Certificate is not submitted, UDYAM (Micro & Small Category)/ Startup Certificate to be submitted for claimi ng of exemption. 5) Turnover Certificate: Firm must submit turnover certificate duly signed by registered CA. In case Turn over Certificate is not submitted, UDYAM (Micro & Small Category)/Start-up Certificate to be submitted for claiming of exemption.

. 9. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 10. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) As per Annexure A 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file.
